# AGT-EVAL-02

**Is reliability measured over repeated runs, and is the agent tested against injection and hijacking?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI agent lens](ai-agent.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | EVAL: Evaluating behaviour |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |

## Rule

An eval's metric names repeated trials (for example pass^k), and an eval of kind red-team exists.

## Sources

- Yao et al., tau-bench, and the pass^k reliability measure (2024) (`tau-bench`)
- Debenedetti et al., AgentDojo (2024) (`agentdojo`)
- NIST CAISI, agent hijacking evaluations and red-teaming competition (2025, 2026) (`caisi-hijacking`)
